tasks.title: KeyValueType
tasks.instruction: Parse one HTTP command-line item into a dict with key, value, sep and orig. Separators are :, =, := and @. Split at the earliest unescaped separator; if separators overlap at that position, := takes precedence over :. Empty keys/values are allowed. A backslash before a separator escapes the entire separator, including :=; unescape separators in key and value after splitting. orig must be the unchanged input. Missing unescaped separator raises ValueError. This function only parses text and never reads files or sends requests.
